verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ እመ፡ ተኀበይኮ፡ ለዓርክከ፡ ትሁብ፡ እዴከ፡ ለእድው።
verses.translation: My son, if thou become surety for thy friend, thou shalt deliver thine hand to an enemy.

translations.lxx: My son, if thou become surety for thy friend, thou shalt deliver thine hand to an enemy.
translations.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
translations.ron: Fiul meu, dacă te-ai pus chezaş pentru prietenul tău, dacă ai dat mâna pentru altul,
translations.grk: Υἱὲ, ἐὰν ἐγγυήσῃ σὸν φίλον, παραδώσεις σὴν χεῖρα ἐχθρῷ.

verses.geez: ወሥገርት፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ውስተ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ወይትኃጐል፡ በከናፍረ፡ አፉሁ።
verses.translation: For a man's own lips become a strong snare to him, and he is caught with the lips of his own mouth.

translations.lxx: For a man's own lips become a strong snare to him, and he is caught with the lips of his own mouth.
translations.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
translations.ron: Atunci te-ai prins prin făgăduieli ieşite din gura ta şi te-ai legat prin cuvintele gurii tale.
translations.grk: Παγὶς γὰρ ἰσχυρὰ ἀνδρὶ τὰ ἴδια χείλη, καὶ ἁλίσκεται χείλεσιν ἰδίου στόματος.

verses.geez: ግበር፡ ወልድየ፡ ዘአነ፡ እኤዝዘከ፡ ወኄረዓል፡ እስመ፡ እመጻእከ፡ ውስተ፡ እደው፡ እኩያን፡ በእንተ፡ ዓርክከ፡ ኩን፡ ኢተሀካዬ፡ ወወሀኮ፡ ለዓርክከ፡ ዘተሀበይኮ።
verses.translation: My son, do what I command thee, and deliver thyself; for on thy friend's account thou art come into the power of evil men: faint not, but stir up even thy friend for whom thou art become surety.

translations.lxx: My son, do what I command thee, and deliver thyself; for on thy friend's account thou art come into the power of evil men: faint not, but stir up even thy friend for whom thou art become surety.
translations.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
translations.ron: Fă dar, fiul meu, aceasta: o, izbăveşte-te. Şi fiindcă ai căzut în mâinile aproapelui tău, du-te şi cazi la picioarele aproapelui tău şi-l roagă;
translations.grk: Ποίει υἱὲ ἃ ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι, καὶ σώζου· ἥκεις γὰρ εἰς χεῖρας κακῶν διὰ σὸν φίλον· ἴσθι μὴ ἐκλυόμενος, παρόξυνε δὲ καὶ τὸν φίλον σου ὃν ἐνεγγυήσω.

verses.geez: ወኢተሀቦን፡ ንዋመ፡ ለአዕይንቲከ፡ ወኢድቃሰ፡ ለቀራንብቲከ።
verses.translation: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber with thine eyelids;

translations.lxx: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber with thine eyelids;
translations.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
translations.ron: Nu da somn ochilor tăi, nici dormitare genelor tale.
translations.grk: Μὴ δῷς ὕπνον σοῖς ὄμμασι, μηδὲ ἐπινυστάξῃς σοῖς βλεφάροις,

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ትድኃን፡ ከመ፡ ወይጠል፡ እመሥገርት፡ ወከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እመጽፈርት።
verses.translation: that thou mayest deliver thyself as a doe out of the toils, and as a bird out of a snare.

translations.lxx: that thou mayest deliver thyself as a doe out of the toils, and as a bird out of a snare.
translations.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
translations.ron: Şi te izbăveşte ca o căprioară din mâna vânătorului şi ca o pasăre din mâna păsărarului.
translations.grk: ἵνα σώζῃ ὥσπερ δορκὰς ἐκ βρόχων, καὶ ὥσπερ ὄρνεον ἐκ παγίδος.

verses.geez: ተመየጥ፡ ኀበ፡ ቃሕም፡ ኦ፡ ሀካይ፡ ወኢትኩን፡ ሀካየ፡ ወቅናእ፡ ርእየከ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ወኩን፡ ጠቢበ፡ እምኔሁ።
verses.translation: Go to the ant, O sluggard; and see, and emulate his ways, and become wiser than he.

translations.lxx: Go to the ant, O sluggard; and see, and emulate his ways, and become wiser than he.
translations.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
translations.ron: Du-te, leneşule, la furnică şi vezi munca ei şi prinde minte!
translations.grk: Ἴθι πρὸς τὸν μύρμηκα ὦ ὀκνηρὲ, καὶ ζήλωσον ἰδὼν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ γενοῦ ἐκείνου σοφώτερος.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ እንዘ፡ ወፍር፡ አልቦ፡ ወዘሂ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያጌብሮ፡ ወእንዘ፡ እግዚእ፡ አልቦ፡ ያስተጋብእ፡ በሐጋይ፡ ሲሳዮ፡ ብዙኀ፡ አመ፡ ማእረር፡ ወይትጌበር፡ ዘያነብር።
verses.translation: For whereas he has no husbandry, nor any one to compel him, and is under no master,

translations.lxx: For whereas he has no husbandry, nor any one to compel him, and is under no master,
translations.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
translations.ron: Ea, care nu are nici mai-mare peste ea, nici îndrumător, nici sfătuitor,
translations.grk: Ἐκείνῳ γὰρ γεωργίου μὴ ὑπάρχοντος, μηδὲ τὸν ἀναγκάζοντα ἔχων, μηδὲ ὑπὸ δεσπότην ὢν,

verses.geez: አው፡ ሑር፡ ኀበ፡ ንኅብ፡ ወአእምር፡ ከመ፡ መስተገብርት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወትግብርታሂ፡ ከመ፡ ሠናየ፡ ትገብር፡ እንተ፡ ፃማሃ፡ ነገሥት፡ ዓብዳን፡ ይነሥኡ፡ ለሕይወት፡ እንተ፡ ትትፈቅድ፡ ይእቲ፡ በኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወክብርት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወበኃይል፡ ጽብስት፡ ወበግብራሰ፡ ጽንዕት።
verses.translation: he prepares food for himself in the summer, and lays by abundant store in harvest.

translations.lxx: though weak in body, she is advanced by honouring wisdom.
translations.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
translations.ron: Îşi pregăteşte de cu vară hrana ei şi îşi strânge la seceriş mâncare. Sau mergi la albină şi vezi cât e de harnică şi ce lucrare iscusită săvârşeşte. Munca ei o folosesc spre sănătate şi regii şi oamenii de rând. Ea e iubită şi lăudată de toţi, deşi e slabă în putere, dar e minunată cu iscusinţa.
translations.grk: ἐτοιμάζεται θέρους τὴν τροφὴν, πολλήν τε ἐν τῷ ἀμητῷ ποιεῖται τὴν παράθεσιν· ἢ πορεύθητι πρὸς τὴν μέλισσαν, καὶ μάθε ὡς ἐργάτις ἐστὶ, τήν τε ἐργασίαν ὡς σεμνὴν ποιεῖται· ἧς τοὺς πόνους βασιλεῖς καὶ ἰδιῶται πρὸς ὑγίειαν προσφέρονται· ποθεινὴ δέ ἐστι πᾶσι καὶ ἐπίδοξος, καίπερ οὖσα τῇ ῥώμῃ ἀσθενὴς, τὴν σοφίαν τιμήσασα προήχθη.

verses.geez: ጥበበ፡ አክቢራ፡ አስተርአየት፡ እስከ፡ ማእዜኑ፡ ሀካይ፡ ትሰክብ፡ ወማእዜ፡ እምንዋምከ፡ ትነቅሕ።
verses.translation: How long wilt thou lie, O sluggard? and when wilt thou awake out of sleep?

translations.lxx: How long wilt thou lie, O sluggard? and when wilt thou awake out of sleep?
translations.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
translations.ron: Până când, leneşule, vei mai sta culcat? Când te vei scula din somnul tău?
translations.grk: Ἕως τίνος ὀκνηρὲ κατάκεισαι; πότε δὲ ἐξ ὕπνου ἐγερθήσῃ;

verses.geez: ሕቀ፡ ትነውም፡ ወሕቀ፡ ትነብር፡ ሕቀ፡ ትዴቅስ፡ ወሕቀ፡ ታስተጋብእ፡ እዴከ፡ ዲበ፡ እንግድዓከ።
verses.translation: Thou sleepest a little, and thou restest a little, and thou slumberest a short time, and thou foldest thine arms over thy breast a little.

translations.lxx: Thou sleepest a little, and thou restest a little, and thou slumberest a short time, and thou foldest thine arms over thy breast a little.
translations.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
translations.ron: Puţin somn, încă puţină aţipire, puţin să mai stau în pat cu mâinile încrucişate!
translations.grk: ὀλίγον μὲν ὑπνοῖς, ὀλίγον δὲ κάθησαι, μικρὸν δὲ νυστάζεις, ὀλίγον δὲ ἐναγκαλίζῃ χερσὶ στήθη.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ይመጽእከ፡ ግብተ፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ሐዋርያ፡ ንዴት፡ ወተፅናስ፡ ከመ፡ ኄር፡ ረዋጺ።
verses.translation: Then poverty comes upon thee as an evil traveller, and want as a swift courier:

translations.lxx: but if thou be diligent, thine harvest shall arrive as a fountain, and poverty shall flee away as a bad courier.
translations.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
translations.ron: Iată vine sărăcia ca un trecător şi nevoia te prinde ca un tâlhar. Dar dacă nu vei lenevi, atunci va veni secerişul tău ca un izvor, iar lipsa va fi departe de tine.
translations.grk: Εἶτʼ ἐνπαραγίνεταί σοι ὥσπερ κακὸς ὁδοιπόρος ἡ πενία, καὶ ἡ ἔνδεια ὥσπερ ἀγαθὸς δρομεύς· ἐὰν δὲ ἄοκνος ᾖς, ἥξει ὥσπερ πηγὴ ὁ ἀμητός σου· ἡ δὲ ἔνδεια, ὥσπερ κακὸς δρομεὺς ἀπαυτομολήσει.

verses.geez: ወእመሰ፡ ኢኮንከ፡ ሀካየ፡ ይመጽአከ፡ ከመ፡ ነቅዕ፡ ማእረርከ፡ ወንዴትሰ፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ረዋጺ፡ ለሊሁ፡ ይርኅቅ፡ እምኔከ።
verses.translation: A foolish man and a transgressor goes in ways that are not good.

translations.lxx: A foolish man and a transgressor goes in ways that are not good.
translations.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
translations.ron: Omul de nimic, omul necinstit şi viclean umblă cu minciuna pe buze.
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ ἄφρων καὶ παράνομος πορεύεται ὁδοὺς οὐκ ἀγαθάς.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ዓብድ፡ ወዓማፂ፡ የሐውር፡ ፍናወ፡ ዘኢኮና፡ ኄራተ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይቀጽብ፡ በዓይን፡ ወያኤምር፡ በእግር፡ ወያኤምር፡ በቅጽበተ፡ አፃብዕ።
verses.translation: And the same winks with the eye, and makes a sign with his foot, and teaches with the beckonings of his fingers.

translations.lxx: And the same winks with the eye, and makes a sign with his foot, and teaches with the beckonings of his fingers.
translations.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
translations.ron: Face cu ochiul, dă din picioare, face semne cu degetele.
translations.grk: Ὁ δʼ αὐτὸς ἐννεύει ὀφθαλμῷ, σημαίνει δὲ ποδὶ, διδάσκει δὲ ἐννεύμασι δακτύλων.

verses.geez: ወዕሉት፡ ልብ፡ ትሔሊ፡ እኩየ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ያመጽእ፡ ሀከከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሀገር።
verses.translation: His perverse heart devises evils: at all times such a one causes troubles to a city.

translations.lxx: His perverse heart devises evils: at all times such a one causes troubles to a city.
translations.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
translations.ron: în inima lui e vicleşug, pururea se gândeşte la rău şi seamănă gâlceavă.
translations.grk: Διεστραμμένη καρδία τεκταίνεται κακὰ, ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ὁ τοιοῦτος ταραχὰς συνίστησιν πόλει.

verses.geez: ወእንቲአሁ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ግብተ፡ ሕጒለት፡ ወዝብጠት፡ ወቅጥቃጤ፡ ዘኢየሐዩ።
verses.translation: Therefore his destruction shall come suddenly; overthrow and irretrievable ruin.

translations.lxx: Therefore his destruction shall come suddenly; overthrow and irretrievable ruin.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta fără de veste va veni peste el prăpădul, nimicit va fi dintr-o dată şi fără leac.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξαπίνης ἔρχεται ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτοῦ, διακοπὴ καὶ συντριβὴ ἀνίατος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ በኵሉ፡ ዘይጸልእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይትቀጠቀጥ፡ በእንተ፡ ርኵሰ፡ ነፍሱ።
verses.translation: For he rejoices in all things which God hates, and he is ruined by reason of impurity of soul.

translations.lxx: For he rejoices in all things which God hates, and he is ruined by reason of impurity of soul.
translations.kjv: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
translations.ron: Şase sunt lucrurile pe care le urăşte Domnul, ba chiar şapte de care se scârbeşte cugetul Său:
translations.grk: Ὅτι χαίρει πᾶσιν οἷς μισεῖ ὁ Θεὸς, συντρίβεται δὲ διʼ ἀκαθαρσίαν ψυχῆς.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ስሱ፡ ዘይጸልእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወሳብዖምሰ፡ ሰቆራረ፡ ነፍሱ።
verses.translation: The eye of the haughty, a tongue unjust, hands shedding the blood of the just;

translations.lxx: The eye of the haughty, a tongue unjust, hands shedding the blood of the just;
translations.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
translations.ron: Ochii mândri, limba mincinoasă, mâinile care varsă sânge nevinovat,
translations.grk: Ὀφθαλμὸς ὑβριστοῦ, γλῶσσα ἄδικος· χεῖρες ἐκχέουσαι αἷμα δικαίου,

verses.geez: ዓይነ፡ ጸአሌ፡ ወልሳነ፡ ዓማፄ፡ ወእደ፡ ዘይክዑ፡ ደመ፡ ጻድቅ።
verses.translation: and a heart devising evil thoughts, and feet hastening to do evil,—are hateful to God.

translations.lxx: and a heart devising evil thoughts, and feet hastening to do evil,—are hateful to God.
translations.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
translations.ron: Inima care plănuieşte gânduri viclene, picioare grabnice să alerge spre rău,
translations.grk: καὶ καρδία τεκταινομένη λογισμοὺς κακοὺς, καὶ πόδες ἐπισπεύδοντες κακοποιεῖν.

verses.geez: ወልበ፡ እንተ፡ ትወልድ፡ እኩየ፡ ሕሊና፡ ወአእጋረ፡ እለ፡ ይትወላወላ፡ ለገቢረ፡ እከይ።
verses.translation: An unjust witness kindles falsehoods, and brings on quarrels between brethren.

translations.lxx: An unjust witness kindles falsehoods, and brings on quarrels between brethren.
translations.kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
translations.ron: Martorul mincinos care spune minciuni şi cel care seamănă vrajbă între fraţi.
translations.grk: Ἐκκαίει ψευδῆ μάρτυς ἄδικος, καὶ ἐπιπέμπει κρίσεις ἀναμέσον ἀδελφῶν.

verses.geez: ወዘያነድድ፡ ስምዐ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ወይፌኑ፡ ጋእዘ፡ ማእከለ፡ አኀው።
verses.translation: My son, keep the laws of thy father, and reject not the ordinances of thy mother:

translations.lxx: My son, keep the laws of thy father, and reject not the ordinances of thy mother:
translations.kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
translations.ron: Păzeşte, fiule, povaţa tatălui tău şi nu lepăda îndemnul maicii tale.
translations.grk: Υἱὲ, φύλασσε νόμους πατρός σου, καὶ μὴ ἀπώσῃ θεσμοὺς μητρός σου·

verses.geez: ዕቀብ፡ ወልድየ፡ ሕገገ፡ አቡከ፡ ወኢትትኀየይ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ እምከ።
verses.translation: but bind them upon thy soul continually, and hang them as a chain about thy neck.

translations.lxx: but bind them upon thy soul continually, and hang them as a chain about thy neck.
translations.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
translations.ron: Leagă-le la inima ta, pururea atârnă-le de gâtul tău.
translations.grk: Ἄφαψαι δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ σῇ ψυχῇ διαπαντὸς, καὶ ἐλκλοίωσαι περὶ σῷ τραχήλῳ·

verses.geez: ደዮ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወጠብልሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሳድከ።
verses.translation: Whensoever thou walkest, lead this along and let it be with thee; and when thou sleepest let it keep thee; that it may talk with thee when thou wakest.

translations.lxx: Whensoever thou walkest, lead this along and let it be with thee; and when thou sleepest let it keep thee; that it may talk with thee when thou wakest.
translations.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
translations.ron: Ele te vor conduce când vei vrea să mergi; în vremea somnului te vor păzi, iar când te vei deştepta vor grăi cu tine.
translations.grk: Ἡνίκα ἂν περιπατῇς, ἐπάγου αὐτὴν καὶ μετὰ σοῦ ἔστω, ὡς δʼ ἂν καθεύδῃς φυλασσέτω σε, ἵνα ἐγειρομένῳ συλλαλῇ σοι.

verses.geez: ወሶበኒ፡ ተሐውር፡ ንሥኦ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወየሀሉ፡ ወሶበኒ፡ ትነውም፡ የዓቅበከ፡ ወሶበኒ፡ ትትነሣእ፡ ይትናገረከ።
verses.translation: For the commandment of the law is a lamp and a light; a way of life; reproof also and correction:

translations.lxx: For the commandment of the law is a lamp and a light; a way of life; reproof also and correction:
translations.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
translations.ron: Că povaţa este un sfeşnic bun şi legea o lumină, iar îndemnurile care dau învăţătură sunt calea vieţii.
translations.grk: Ὅτι λύχνος ἐντολὴ νόμου καὶ φῶς, ὁδὸς ζωῆς, καὶ ἔλεγχος καὶ παιδεία,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ማኅቶት፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ወሕግ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወፍኖተ፡ ሕይወት፡ ተግሣፅ፡ ወትምህርት።
verses.translation: to keep thee continually from a married woman, and from the calumny of a strange tongue.

translations.lxx: to keep thee continually from a married woman, and from the calumny of a strange tongue.
translations.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
translations.ron: Ele te vor păzi de femeia vicleană, de limba cea ademenitoare a celei străine.
translations.grk: τοῦ διαφυλάσσειν σε ἀπὸ γυναικὸς ὑπάνδρου, καὶ ἀπὸ διαβολῆς γλώσσης ἀλλοτρίας.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ ከመ፡ ትዕቀብከ፡ እምብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወእምውዴተ፡ ልሳን፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: Let not the desire of beauty overcome thee, neither be thou caught by thine eyes, neither be captivated with her eyelids.

translations.lxx: Let not the desire of beauty overcome thee, neither be thou caught by thine eyes, neither be captivated with her eyelids.
translations.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
translations.ron: Nu dori frumuseţea ei întru inima ta şi să nu te vâneze cu genele ei.
translations.grk: Μή σε νικήσῃ κάλλους ἐπιθυμία, μηδὲ ἀγρευθῇς σοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς, μηδὲ συναρπασθῇς ἀπὸ τῶν αὐτῆς βλεφάρων.

verses.geez: ኢይማዕከ፡ ሥነ፡ ፍትወታ፡ ወኢትሠገር፡ በአዕይንቲሃ፡ ወኢትትመሠጥ፡ በቀራንብቲሃ።
verses.translation: For the value of a harlot is as much as of one loaf; and a woman hunts for the precious souls of men.

translations.lxx: For the value of a harlot is as much as of one loaf; and a woman hunts for the precious souls of men.
translations.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
translations.ron: Că femeia desfrânată umblă după o bucată de pâine, pe când femeia-soţie doreşte un suflet de mare preţ.
translations.grk: Τιμὴ γὰρ πόρνης ὅση καὶ ἑνὸς ἄρτου, γυνὴ δὲ ἀνδρῶν τιμίας ψυχὰς ἀγρεύει.

verses.geez: ፍቅራ፡ ለዘማ፡ እስከ፡ አሐቲ፡ ኅብስት፡ ወብእስትሰ፡ ለእይው፡ ክቡራን፡ ታኀጒል፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ ወታሤግር።
verses.translation: Shall any one bind fire in his bosom, and not burn his garments?

translations.lxx: Shall any one bind fire in his bosom, and not burn his garments?
translations.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
translations.ron: Oare poate pune cineva foc în sânul lui, fără ca veşmintele lui să nu ardă?
translations.grk: Ἀποδήσει τις πῦρ ἐν κόλπῳ, τὰ δὲ ἱμάτια οὐ κατακαύσει;

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ዘየዓቊር፡ እሳተ፡ ውስተ፡ ኅፅኑ፡ ወአልባሲሁ፡ ኢይውዕያ።
verses.translation: or will any one walk on coals of fire, and not burn his feet?

translations.lxx: or will any one walk on coals of fire, and not burn his feet?
translations.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
translations.ron: Sau va merge cineva pe cărbuni fără să i se frigă tălpile?
translations.grk: ἢ περιπατήσει τις ἐπʼ ἀνθράκων πυρὸς, τοὺς δὲ πόδας οὐ κατακαύσει;

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ዲበ፡ አፍሐመ፡ እሳት፡ ወእገሪሁ፡ ኢይውዕያ።
verses.translation: So is he that goes in to a married woman; he shall not be held guiltless, neither any one that touches her.

translations.lxx: So is he that goes in to a married woman; he shall not be held guiltless, neither any one that touches her.
translations.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
translations.ron: Aşa este cu cel ce se duce la femeia aproapelui său: nimeni din cei ce se ating de ea nu va rămâne nepedepsit.
translations.grk: Οὕτως ὁ εἰσελθὼν πρὸς γυναῖκα ὕπανδρον, οὐκ ἀθωωθήσεται, οὐδὲ πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ ዘይበውእ፡ ቤተ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኢይነጽሕ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘይለክፋ።
verses.translation: It is not to be wondered at if one should be taken stealing, for he steals that when hungry he may satisfy his soul:

translations.lxx: It is not to be wondered at if one should be taken stealing, for he steals that when hungry he may satisfy his soul:
translations.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
translations.ron: Nimeni nu dispreţuieşte un hoţ pentru că a furat ca să-şi astâmpere foamea;
translations.grk: Οὐ θαυμαστὸν ἐὰν ἁλῷ τις κλέπτων, κλέπτει γὰρ ἵνα ἐμπλήσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν πεινῶν.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ መንክር፡ እመ፡ ተእኀዘ፡ ሰራቂ፡ ዘይሰርቅ፡ እስመ፡ ይሰርቅ፡ ከመ፡ ያጽግብ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ርኅብተ።
verses.translation: but if he should be taken, he shall repay sevenfold, and shall deliver himself by giving all his goods.

translations.lxx: but if he should be taken, he shall repay sevenfold, and shall deliver himself by giving all his goods.
translations.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
translations.ron: Dar când a fost prins, el dă înapoi înşeptit, întoarce tot ceea ce are în casa lui.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁλῷ, ἀποτίσει ἑπταπλάσια, καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ δοὺς ῥύσεται ἑσυτόν.

verses.geez: ወለእመ፡ ተእኅዘ፡ ይፈዲ፡ ምስብዒተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ጥሪቶ፡ ይሁብ፡ ከመ፡ ያድኅን፡ ነፍሶ።
verses.translation: But the adulterer through want of sense procures destruction to his soul.

translations.lxx: But the adulterer through want of sense procures destruction to his soul.
translations.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
translations.ron: Cel ce se desfrânează însă cu o femeie este lipsit de minte, se pierde pe el însuşi făcând astfel;
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ μοιχὸς διʼ ἔνδειαν φρενῶν ἀπώλειαν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ περιποιεῖται,

verses.geez: ወመሐዝሰ፡ በንዴተ፡ አእምሮ፡ ኀጒለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ይትጌበር።
verses.translation: He endures both pain and disgrace, and his reproach shall never be wiped off.

translations.lxx: He endures both pain and disgrace, and his reproach shall never be wiped off.
translations.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
translations.ron: El nu dobândeşte decât bătaie, iar ocara lui niciodată nu se şterge.
translations.grk: ὀδύνας τε καὶ ἀτιμίας ὑποφέρει, τὸ δὲ ὄνειδος αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.geez: ሕማመ፡ ወኀሣረ፡ ይጼውዕ፡ ወጽእለቱ፡ ኢይደመሰስ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
verses.translation: For the soul of her husband is full of jealousy: he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

translations.lxx: For the soul of her husband is full of jealousy: he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
translations.kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
translations.ron: Pizma trezeşte mânia omului defăimat şi el este fără milă în ziua răzbunării;
translations.grk: Μεστὸς γὰρ ζήλου θυμὸς ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς, οὐ φείσεται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ምሉዕ፡ ምታ፡ ቅንአተ፡ ወመዓተ፡ ወኢይምሕሮ፡ በዕለተ፡ ኵነኔ።
verses.translation: He will not forego his enmity for any ransom: neither will he be reconciled for many gifts.

translations.lxx: He will not forego his enmity for any ransom: neither will he be reconciled for many gifts.
translations.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
translations.ron: El nu se uită la nici un preţ de răscumpărare, şi chiar când îi vei spori darurile, tot nu se îmblânzeşte.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἀνταλλάξεται οὐδενὸς λύτρου τὴν ἔχθραν, οὐδὲ μὴ διαλυθῇ πολλῶν δώρων.

verses.geez: ወኢይትዌለጥ፡ በምንትኒ፡ ባዛ፡ ጽልእ፡ ወኢይትዓረቆ፡ ወብዙኅ፡ ሀብት።
